hack.root_cause: Unvalidated arbitrary call in new router — transferFrom injection via approval drain
hack.description: Unibot's new unverified router was exploited for $640K via an unvalidated arbitrary call that let attackers drain token approvals from user wallets, with copycat exploitation continuing after the announcement because the team failed to warn users to revoke.
